mapper.select: /*selectBuyerMpSoUniformGrHistoryPopDtList*/ SELECT A.BUYER, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.ST_NO, A.ST_SEQ, B.REVISION, TO_CHAR(A.ADD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ADD_DATE, A.ITEM_QTY, TO_CHAR(B.GR_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS GR_DATE, B.GR_QTY FROM KEP_BUYER_ST_PODT A, KEP_BUYER_ST_GRDT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.ST_NO = B.ST_NO AND A.ST_SEQ = B.ST_SEQ AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_buyer_item_no} ORDER BY A.ST_NO, A.ST_SEQ, B.REVISION
